summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily buyback disclosures provided to the ASX under its $1 billion stock repurchase program. The program authorizes the company to acquire shares of Class A and Class B common stock from time to time. No specific price, premium, or date terms are stated; the filing is an ongoing disclosure of transactions under an existing authorization. The board has previously approved the program. The filing serves as a routine update rather than a new event. Watch for aggregate repurchase pace and market conditions affecting execution.
